name: app-health-score-phone-planted-in-quilted-white-cushion
title: Health Score Phone in a Quilted Cushion
whatItIs: A phone tilted and planted into a puffy white quilted cushion inside a rounded grey panel, showing an AI health score of 92% with a sunburst, calorie, water, sleep and heart-rate cards.
whatItMeans: The soft padded prop suggests comfort and care, and the neutral scene keeps the pastel UI in focus.
techniques: Soft quilted object as a stage
Small coloured icons per health metric
Sunburst line graphic beside the score

vocabulary.definition: A padded or quilted object used as a stage.
A single number summarising overall wellbeing.
A 2-by-2 layout of small stat cards.
